name: school_reporting
summary: Payment status, income-by-category, and defaulters read-models for reporting/export
description: Reporting read-models for the school payment system: per-student payment status by class/section/academic year with fee required, paid and balance; income aggregated by fee category across daily/monthly/quarterly/yearly periods; and a defaulters list of students with outstanding balances including overdue months and accumulated penalties. Rows are refreshed snapshots intended for viewing and export.
author: Nexa
